questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective materials at night to be more visible to other drivers. Bright colors with reflective materials help other road users see you.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, ride in the left portion of your lane because:

options.text: You cannot see as far ahead
It blocks your view of the vehicle
It lets the other driver speed up

questions.explanation: Riding on the left side of your lane helps you see more road ahead. It also makes you more visible to drivers in the passing lane.

questions.question: For the best protection, your helmet should:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets DOT standards. It should fit snugly all around your head with no loose areas or damage.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Skip your jacket in warm weather
Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather
questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even when it is warm. A jacket protects you and helps prevent dehydration. Wear long pants and tuck in your shoelaces so they do not catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: Carrying a passenger on a motorcycle:

options.text: Does not change how the motorcycle handles
Is good practice for new riders

questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle, which changes how it handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: Motorcycle signals are:

options.text: More important than signals on cars and trucks
Only needed when another vehicle is right next to you
Less important than signals on cars and trucks

questions.correctAnswerText: More important than signals on cars and trucks
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists are more vulnerable than car and truck drivers. Using signals correctly is even more important for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Assume they have ridden a motorcycle before
Explain the process and not assume they know what to do
Not explain anything since they are not in control

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain the process and not assume they know what to do
questions.explanation: Never assume your passenger knows how to ride safely. Give them complete instructions before every ride so both of you stay safe.

questions.question: A face shield:

options.text: Does not protect as well as goggles

questions.explanation: A plastic, impact-resistant face shield gives the best protection for your eyes and face. Glasses or sunglasses are not enough. In Vermont, a windshield can substitute for eye protection, though protection is still recommended.

questions.question: A rectangular sign is usually a:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs like speed limits are rectangular with white backgrounds and black text or symbols. You must follow the rules shown on these signs.

questions.question: A motorcycle has the best traction on:
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers all reduce tire traction. Dry pavement provides the best traction for motorcycles.

questions.question: What should motorcycle rider pants be made of for protection?

options.text: Material that flaps in the wind.
Short material that leaves legs exposed.

questions.explanation: Wear pants made of leather or sturdy material that cover your entire legs. Pants should fit snugly so they don't flap but should not restrict your movement.

questions.question: What should you NOT check on your tires?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire air pressure, tread, and general wear. You do not need to check tire flexibility.

questions.question: How much alcohol does the body remove per hour?
questions.explanation: The body removes about one drink of alcohol per hour on average.

questions.question: When braking your motorcycle, what should you use?

options.text: Either brake, but not both at the same time.

questions.explanation: Use both brakes at the same time to stop. Using both brakes together is the most effective way to stop.

questions.question: What material offers the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather provides the best protection for motorcycle riders. Always wear clothing that covers your arms and legs completely.

questions.question: What kind of soles should motorcycle riding boots have?
questions.explanation: Choose boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: What should you NOT check before riding your motorcycle?

options.text: That the brake light works when you use the brakes.
That the paint is not scratched.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the paint is not scratched.
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire pressure and condition, oil and fluid levels, and that all lights work. You do not need to check for paint scratches.

questions.question: When should you use your mirrors?

options.text: When you are stopped at an intersection

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal scanning. Always use your mirrors before changing lanes, when stopping at an intersection, and before slowing down.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, what is still true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
You may still feel side effects from drinking.
You will be safe as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may still feel side effects from drinking.
questions.explanation: While the body removes about one drink per hour, alcohol can still build up in your system. Your judgment and abilities can still be impaired even if you wait an hour.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle operator slow down?
questions.explanation: Downshifting is a common way to slow down. Remember that downshifting does not activate the brake lights.

questions.question: What is smooth downshifting on motorcycles used for?

options.text: It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle down.
You should not do it around other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle down.
questions.explanation: Smooth downshifting can use the engine to slow down your motorcycle. If you use engine braking, use your brake lights separately so other drivers know you are slowing down.

questions.question: What color are warning signs?

options.text: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
Blue with white lettering or symbols
White with black lettering or symbols
Red with white lettering or symbols

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: When should you inspect your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Inspect your motorcycle thoroughly before every ride. Small problems on a motorcycle are more dangerous than on a car.

questions.question: What is the safest practice for motorcycle maintenance?

options.text: Assume everything on your motorcycle works properly
Inspect your motorcycle before every ride
Inspect your motorcycle once a month
Inspect your motorcycle twice a week

questions.correctAnswerText: Inspect your motorcycle before every ride
questions.explanation: Small mechanical problems are more serious on a motorcycle than on a car. Always inspect your motorcycle thoroughly before every ride.

questions.question: What effect can wind noise have during long motorcycle rides?

options.text: It is good for your hearing
It is safer than listening to music

questions.explanation: Wind noise during long rides can harm your hearing, even with a helmet. Use hearing protection to prevent damage.
